launches.title: Isoquant: Recursively self-improving inference cloud for 4x faster AI models
launches.tagline: Isoquant auto-research agents continuously optimize the inference stack to make customer workloads run faster.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Speed is the moat. Isoquant is a self-optimizing inference cloud. Our auto-research agents continuously optimize and iterate on the inference stack to push the limits of speed and cost efficiency, tuned for our customer workloads and hardware. We serve 4x faster open models than other providers in prod crossing 1200 tokens/sec and sub-500ms latency. We started a month ago and are already serving 1.5+ trillion tokens, 3200 users and growing 40% week-over-week.

Want ultra fast inference API or 4x more performance out of your existing hardware? Reach out to [founders@isoquant.ai](mailto:founders@isoquant.ai) or book a time <https://isoquant.ai/contact>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=129257&key=user_uploads/355672/c982b3bb-edaa-4dee-bfd2-9602dadf860b)

### **Problem**

AI is going to eat the world but capacity is the bottleneck. GPUs are already powerful but severely underutilized. Every company and use-case has a different workload shape. Off-the-shelf inference is slow and inefficient. Inference not tuned for a workload can leave 50–80% of performance on the table. Companies get slower responses and pay more per token than they need to.

As hardware gets more complex and harder to program, more of that complexity falls on the software. New models ship and workloads change, so keeping the serving stack efficient takes continuous experimentation and inference engineering.

### **Solution**

Customers bring us their workloads and performance benchmarks. Our auto-research agents continuously optimize and iterate on the complete inference stack to push the limits of speed and cost efficiency, tuned for their workloads and hardware. Our research agents run experiments across areas such as GPU kernels, memory, decoding, caching, and scheduling to get maximum performance out of the hardware, passing the performance gains and cost savings on to our customers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=129257&key=user_uploads/355672/6dbadcd3-df1d-4716-aa3d-765c88921df3)

### **Traction**

* We started a month ago and are already serving 1.5+ trillion tokens, 3200 users and growing 40% week-over-week.
* We serve 4x faster open models than other providers in prod crossing 1200 tokens/sec and sub-500ms latency. 
* Customers across North America, Europe, and APAC are moving workloads from other inference providers and self-hosted deployments to Isoquant for ultrafast and cost-efficient models.

### **Our Asks**

1. Book a meeting if you have latency-sensitive workloads and care about cost-efficiency <https://isoquant.ai/contact> 
2. Know a team that needs faster inference? We’d love an introduction [founders@isoquant.ai](mailto:founders@isoquant.ai) 
3. Try our DeepSeek 4.1 Flash 1017 Fast API to experience the speed firsthand. Get an API key at <https://isoquant.ai/>

### **Team**

Aniket and Mugdhaa have been best friends for almost 10 years and co-founded Isoquant in 2026.

Aniket (CEO) was previously at Meta Superintelligence Labs and Instagram, where he worked on post-training, inference, and agent-orchestration. He grew Meta AI monthly active users by \~250K by improving latency, built critical parts of post-training data flywheel, optimized Instagram partnership ads algo, and built infra for Meta AI search.

Mugdhaa (CTO) led AI for developer productivity at Snowflake, where she built model harnesses, evals, developer tooling, and orchestration systems that help engineers adopt AI and move faster. Before Snowflake, she worked at Twitch on live video playback and distribution, building systems that keep Twitch reliable at scale for the biggest live events on the internet (Ibai La Velada, MrBeast), serving 10M+ concurrent requests.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=129257&key=user_uploads/355672/b87ca750-6c63-44f3-83ed-8493cb234b9e)

launches.title: Agent FM: One group chat to hear and steer your coding agents.
launches.tagline: Computer use + live audio updates + group chat with your agents. One command center to end agent babysitting.
launches.body:
Hi everyone 👋

We're [Aniket](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anideshp/) & [Mugdhaa](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mugdhaa-patankar/), co-founders of [Agent FM](https://www.agentfm.ai/).

**TL;DR:** Agent FM is a desktop app that gives engineers one group chat to hear and steer their coding agents. Instead of manually bouncing between different claude code and codex sessions, and combing through walls of text to monitor agents, engineers just tune in to Agent FM. Agents share important progress updates, blockers, assumptions, and decisions in the group chat. Engineers get live text and audio updates and respond right from the chat.

**Launch video:** <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bVGLQwclkYI> 

#### The Problem:

**Babysitting agents is exhausting.** Engineers running claude code and codex agents spend all day bouncing between multiple sessions, combing through walls of text to keep track of the work. In long horizon tasks, agents often go down the wrong paths, add unnecessary complexity or make bad assumptions that waste time and tokens. Agents can also sometimes misinterpret instructions, make poor decisions, or perform destructive actions due to lack of context and context compaction. To avoid this, engineers continuously keep tabs on their agents, read agent trajectories realtime for anything substantial worth intercepting. This gets really exhausting with more agents and time. We lack the tooling that automatically does this for engineers.

#### Our Solution:

* **One interface to rule them all:** Computer use + live audio updates + group chat with your agents. One command center to interact with your coding agents without babysitting and manually polling different Claude Code and Codex sessions.
* **Actionable metrics and insights into agent activity across model providers:** Deep insights and metrics about token spend across providers, cost distribution, skills and mcp token performance, and recurring patterns.
* **Works with the tools engineers already use:** No setup needed. Agent FM automatically works across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other coding tools. Local and remote workspaces supported.
* **Voice-to-text AI**: Context aware and low-latency voice-to-text AI to prompt 4x faster anywhere on your computer.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109244&key=user_uploads/355672/6ac94f50-a6ac-4b2d-9290-819f9711037e)

#### Traction

* **410 engineers** are using Agent FM (**60+ paying**), 
* **120k+ audio updates** heard by engineers. 
* **1.2 hours/day** average time spent on Agent FM

#### Our asks

* Give Agent FM a try and let us know what you think: [agentfm.ai](http://agentfm.ai)
* If there’s a team or company you think would benefit with Agent FM, write to us at [founders@agentfm.ai](mailto:founders@agentfm.ai) 

#### The Team:

Aniket and Mugdhaa have known each other for almost 10 years and co-founded Agent FM in 2026.

Aniket (CEO) worked at Meta Superintelligence Labs, where he built agent-orchestration, RL, and search infra, fine-tuned models, grew Meta AI monthly active users by 250K and built critical parts of the Llama training data flywheel.

Mugdhaa (CTO) led AI for developer productivity at Snowflake, where she built model harnesses, evals, developer tooling, and orchestration systems that help engineers adopt AI and move faster. Before Snowflake, she worked at Twitch on live video playback and distribution, building systems that keep Twitch reliable at scale for the biggest live events on the internet (Ibai La Velada, MrBeast), serving 10M+ concurrent requests.
